topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
consensus_response: MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in congestion mitigation through their traffic management approaches. MPLS employs RSVP-TE for precise bandwidth reservation, ensuring low latency and jitter, while IPsec relies on DiffServ prioritization without reservations, risking QoS degradation under congestion. MPLS's admission control and resource blocking better mitigate congestion.
reference_context: MPLS and IPsec VPNs have distinct QoS attributes, with MPLS offering superior congestion control via RSVP-TE.
